segments.text: Hi baby, kaise ho? Kaise ho?

full_text: Hello Hello Hi Hi Hi baby, kaise ho? Kaise ho? Kahan se ho? Assam se. Tum kahan se ho? Gujarat. Gujarat. Kya kar rahe ho? Kuch nahi, bas baitha hoon. Baitha hoon. Tum kya kar rahe ho? Kahan se ho? Tum kya kar rahe ho? Main leti hoon. Kya karungi? Leti hoon.
